title: 第29章 前女友撞见
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳心头一阵激动，点了点头：“行，梅姐，那我明天就等你的消息。”

    柳醉梅轻轻点头，没有再多说什么。

    陈阳转身朝着门口走去，推开门走了出去。

    柳醉梅看着他离去的背影，脸色变得愈发复杂。

    没过多久，桃夭就推门走了进来，看着柳醉梅，语气关切问：“梅姐，你真的没事？小腹还疼不疼？”

    柳醉梅摇了摇头，语气平淡说：“没事了，陈高人的医术确实厉害，一下就治好了。”

    她顿了顿，眼神变得锐利起来，对着桃夭吩咐道：“小桃，你去查查陈阳与苏冰，看看他们有没有上床、开房的记录，一丝线索都不能放过。”

    桃夭脸上再次露出几分古怪，显然没想到柳醉梅会让她查这种事情，但还是不敢违抗，连忙点头：“是，梅姐，我这就去查。”

    说完，她转身快步走开。

    柳醉梅从房间里走出来，站在走廊上，望着窗外，眼神冰冷：“苏冰，我不可能让你赢过我……这个男人也一样……”

    ……

    正午的阳光火辣辣地洒在街道上。

    陈阳走进一家简约干净的快餐店，点了一份简单的午餐，快速吃完后，他拿出手机再次查看。

    刘知柔依旧没有通过微信好友申请，也没有任何回应。

    他索性收起手机，结完账从快餐店出来，抬手拦了一辆出租车，径直回了自己的出租房小区。

    回到出租屋，陈阳走到床边，弯腰从床底暗格中拿出一个不起眼的钱袋，轻轻拍了拍上面的灰尘，确认钱都在里面后，便拎着钱袋转身走出出租屋。

    刚走到单元楼门口，他就停下了脚步，脸上露出几分意外。

    只见唐欣悦正从对面的楼道走过来。

    她穿着一身紧身的白色连衣裙，勾勒出纤细的身段，脸上化着精致的妆容，长发披肩。

    只是眉眼间带着几分急躁和不耐，原本娇俏的脸蛋此刻满是戾气，不复往日的温柔。

    陈阳愣了一下，很快就恢复了平静，收回目光，侧身就要从她身边走开，不想与她有任何纠缠。

    唐欣悦脸色一冷，快步上前拦住了他，语气带着几分质问：“陈阳，你是不是拿了我的毕业证？”
content_en:
Chen Yang felt excited and nodded: "Okay, Sister Mei, then I will wait for your news tomorrow."

Liu Zuimei nodded lightly and said nothing more.

Chen Yang turned around and walked towards the door, opened the door and walked out.

Liu Zuimei looked at his leaving figure, her face becoming more complicated.

Not long after, Taoyao opened the door and walked in. She looked at Liu Zuimei and asked in a concerned tone: "Sister Mei, are you really okay? Does your lower abdomen still hurt?"

Liu Zuimei shook her head and said calmly: "It's okay. Master Chen's medical skills are really great. He was cured in one go."

She paused, her eyes became sharp, and she ordered to Taoyao: "Xiao Tao, go check Chen Yang and Su Bing to see if they have any records of sleeping with each other or renting a room. Don't let go of any clues."

Tao Yao's face showed a bit of weirdness again. She obviously didn't expect Liu Zuimei to ask her to investigate such a thing, but she still didn't dare to disobey and nodded quickly: "Yes, Sister Mei, I will investigate right away."

After saying that, she turned around and walked away quickly.

Liu Zuimei walked out of the room and stood in the corridor, looking out the window with cold eyes: "Su Bing, I can't let you beat me... The same goes for this man..."

…

The midday sun shines brightly on the street.

Chen Yang walked into a simple and clean fast food restaurant and ordered a simple lunch. After eating it quickly, he took out his mobile phone and checked again.

Liu Zhirou still hasn’t applied as a friend on WeChat, nor has she received any response.

He simply put away his mobile phone, paid the bill and came out of the fast food restaurant. He raised his hand to stop a taxi and went straight back to his rental community.

Returning to the rental house, Chen Yang walked to the bedside, bent down and took out an inconspicuous money bag from the secret compartment under the bed, patted the dust on it, and after confirming that the money was inside, he turned around and walked out of the rental house with the money bag.

As soon as he reached the door of the unit building, he stopped, with a bit of surprise on his face.

I saw Tang Xinyue walking from the opposite corridor.

She was wearing a tight-fitting white dress that outlined her slender figure, with delicate makeup on her face and her long hair hanging over her shoulders.

There was just a hint of impatience and impatience in his eyebrows, and his originally pretty face was now full of anger and no longer as gentle as before.

Chen Yang was stunned for a moment, then quickly regained his composure. He withdrew his gaze and turned sideways to walk away from her, not wanting to have any entanglement with her.

Tang Xinyue's face turned cold, and she quickly stepped forward to stop him, and asked in a questioning tone: "Chen Yang, did you take my diploma?"
